text: 3시 30분을 한국어로 바르게 읽은 것은?
gloss: How do you read 3:30 in Korean? — 세 시 삼십 분: hours take the native numerals (세), minutes the Sino-Korean ones (삼십).

text: 스물, 서른, 마흔, 그다음에 오는 우리말 수는?
gloss: Twenty, thirty, forty, and then which native Korean number? — 쉰 (50); 예순 is 60, 일흔 70, 여든 80.

text: ㅅ, ㅏ, ㄴ을 한 글자로 합쳐 쓰면 어떤 글자가 될까?
gloss: Put ㅅ, ㅏ, ㄴ together into one syllable block — 산: the final consonant (batchim) ㄴ goes underneath.

text: 이메일 주소에 꼭 들어가는 ‘@’ 기호를 한국에서는 흔히 무엇이라 부를까?
gloss: What do Koreans commonly call the '@' sign in an e-mail address? — 골뱅이 (a whelk), after its spiral shape.

text: 시장에서 달걀 ‘한 판’을 사면 보통 몇 개를 받을까?
gloss: Buying one 'pan' (tray) of eggs at the market, how many do you usually get? — 30.

text: 만 원짜리 지폐에 그려진 인물은?
gloss: Who is on the 10,000-won note? — King Sejong; Yi Hwang is on the 1,000, Yi I on the 5,000, Shin Saimdang on the 50,000.

text: 2010년 밴쿠버 올림픽에서 금메달을 딴 김연아 선수의 종목은?
gloss: Kim Yu-na won gold at the 2010 Vancouver Olympics in which sport? — figure skating.

text: 드라마 〈오징어 게임〉에서 참가자들이 가장 먼저 치르는 게임은?
gloss: In the series Squid Game, which game do the players play first? — 'Red Light, Green Light' (무궁화 꽃이 피었습니다); dalgona comes second, tug of war third, marbles fourth.

text: 속담 ‘낮말은 새가 듣고 밤말은 ( )가 듣는다’의 빈칸에 들어갈 말은?
gloss: Proverb: 'Day words are heard by birds, night words by ( )' — 쥐 (the mouse): walls have ears, even in private.

text: 응급 환자가 생겨 구급차를 불러야 할 때, 한국에서 누르는 번호는?
gloss: Which number do you dial in Korea for an ambulance? — 119 (112 is the police, 114 directory enquiries).

text: 《흥부와 놀부》에서 흥부가 다리를 고쳐 준 제비가 이듬해 물어다 준 것은?
gloss: In the tale of Heungbu and Nolbu, what did the swallow whose leg Heungbu mended bring him the next year? — a gourd seed (박씨).

text: 고려의 뒤를 이어 조선을 세우고 첫 임금이 된 사람은?
gloss: Who founded Joseon after Goryeo and became its first king? — Yi Seong-gye; Wang Geon founded Goryeo, Jumong Goguryeo, and Kim Yu-sin was a Silla general.

text: 견우와 직녀가 일 년에 한 번 만난다는 칠석은 음력 며칠일까?
gloss: On which lunar date is Chilseok, when the Weaver Girl and the Herdsman meet? — 7th of the 7th month; 3/3 is Samjinnal, 5/5 Dano, 9/9 Jungyangjeol.

text: 방탄소년단 팬덤의 이름은?
gloss: What is the name of BTS's fandom? — ARMY (아미); Blink is Blackpink's, Once Twice's, Carat Seventeen's.

text: 편의점에서 ‘2+1’ 행사 중인 과자를 6개 가져가려면 몇 개 값을 내야 할까?
gloss: At a convenience store with a '2+1' deal (buy two, get one free), how many do you pay for to take six? — 4: two sets of two paid plus one free.

text: 윈도 컴퓨터에서 방금 한 작업을 되돌리는 단축키는 Ctrl과 어느 키일까?
gloss: On a Windows PC, which key with Ctrl undoes the last action? — Z (Y redoes, X cuts, V pastes).

text: 물을 가득 채운 유리병을 냉동실에 얼리면 병이 깨질 수 있다. 왜일까?
gloss: Why can a glass bottle filled with water crack in the freezer? — water expands when it freezes.

text: 에스프레소에 뜨거운 물을 부어 만드는 커피는?
gloss: Which coffee is an espresso topped up with hot water? — Americano (a latte and cappuccino use milk, a mocha chocolate).

text: 인천국제공항이 자리한 섬은?
gloss: On which island is Incheon International Airport? — Yeongjong-do (joined to Yongyu-do by land reclamation).

text: 해리 포터가 다니는 마법 학교의 이름은?
gloss: What is the name of the wizarding school Harry Potter attends? — Hogwarts; Beauxbatons, Durmstrang and Ilvermorny are other schools in the books.

text: 가을 길가에서 고약한 냄새가 나는 은행 열매는 어느 은행나무에 열릴까?
gloss: Which ginkgo trees bear the foul-smelling seeds on autumn streets? — Female trees; that is why cities now plant male ones.

text: 로마 숫자 XIV는 얼마를 뜻할까?
gloss: What does the Roman numeral XIV mean? — 14: X (10) plus IV (4); 16 would be XVI.

text: 겨울에 문고리를 잡을 때 ‘찌릿’ 하는 정전기가 잘 생기는 날씨는?
gloss: In which weather do you get a static shock from a door handle in winter? — dry days; moist air lets charge leak away.

text: 애니메이션 〈겨울왕국〉에서 엘사가 만들어 낸 눈사람의 이름은?
gloss: In Frozen, what is the name of the snowman Elsa creates? — Olaf (Sven is a reindeer, Hans a prince, Kristoff an ice harvester).

text: 콘서트가 끝난 뒤 관객이 ‘앙코르!’를 외치는 것은 무엇을 청하는 걸까?
gloss: What are fans asking for when they shout 'encore'? — one more song.

text: 야구에서 타자가 볼을 네 개 얻어 내면 어떻게 될까?
gloss: In baseball, what happens when a batter gets four balls? — a walk (볼넷): he takes first base.

text: 1989년 베를린 장벽이 무너진 뒤 이듬해 통일을 이룬 나라는?
gloss: After the Berlin Wall fell in 1989, which country reunified the following year? — Germany (3 October 1990).

text: 〈포켓몬스터〉의 대표 캐릭터 피카추의 타입은?
gloss: What type is Pikachu in Pokémon? — Electric.

text: 가나다순으로 사전에 가장 먼저 나오는 낱말은?
gloss: Which word comes first in Korean alphabetical order? — 가방: same start, then no final consonant (가) comes before 감, then ㅏ before ㅐ (개) and ㅓ (거).

text: 띠는 쥐, 소, 호랑이, 토끼 순으로 돌아간다. 토끼띠 바로 다음 해에 태어난 사람의 띠는?
gloss: The zodiac runs rat, ox, tiger, rabbit; what is the sign of the year right after the rabbit? — dragon (용).

text: 《홍길동전》의 홍길동이 아버지를 ‘아버지’라 부르지 못해 한탄한 것은 그가 무엇이었기 때문일까?
gloss: Why could Hong Gil-dong not call his father 'father' in the novel? — he was a secondary-wife's son (서자), barred from the family's full status.

text: 조선 시대에 비가 내린 양을 재던 기구는?
gloss: Which Joseon instrument measured rainfall? — the cheugugi (rain gauge); jagyeongnu is a water clock, angbuilgu a sundial, honcheonui an armillary sphere.

text: 오늘이 수요일이라면 ‘글피’는 무슨 요일일까?
gloss: If today is Wednesday, what day is 글피? — Saturday: 모레 is +2 (Friday), 글피 is the day after that, +3.

text: 좁은 방에서 냉장고 문을 활짝 열어 두면 방 안 온도는 어떻게 될까?
gloss: With the fridge door open in a small closed room, what happens to the room's temperature? — it rises slightly: the fridge's motor adds heat and removes none from the room.

text: 부엉이와 올빼미 가운데 머리에 귀처럼 솟은 깃털(귀깃)이 있는 쪽은?
gloss: Of 부엉이 and 올빼미, which has ear-like tufts on its head? — 부엉이 (eagle-owls, horned owls); 올빼미 have round heads without tufts.

text: 웹사이트 주소 맨 앞의 ‘https’에서 s는 무엇을 뜻할까?
gloss: In 'https', what does the 's' stand for? — Secure (the connection is encrypted).

text: 다음 중 아프리카에 있지 않은 나라는?
gloss: Which of these countries is not in Africa? — Venezuela (South America).

text: 〈엘리제를 위하여〉를 작곡한 사람은?
gloss: Who composed 'Für Elise'? — Beethoven.

text: 얼굴을 앞과 옆에서 동시에 본 듯 그리는 입체주의의 대표 화가는?
gloss: Which painter is the leading Cubist, drawing a face seen from front and side at once? — Picasso.

text: 카레를 노랗게 물들이는 향신료는?
gloss: Which spice turns curry yellow? — turmeric (강황).

text: 증기 기관을 크게 개량했고, 이름이 전력의 단위로 남은 사람은?
gloss: Who greatly improved the steam engine and gave his name to the unit of power? — James Watt; Volta, Ampère and Ohm gave theirs to volt, ampere and ohm.

text: 사람을 한 번 쏘면 침이 빠져 죽는 벌은?
gloss: Which bee dies after stinging a person once, as its barbed sting is torn out? — the honeybee; wasps can sting repeatedly.

text: 수원 화성을 쌓을 때 도르래 원리를 이용한 거중기를 설계한 실학자는?
gloss: Which Silhak scholar designed the pulley-based crane (geojunggi) used to build Hwaseong Fortress in Suwon? — Jeong Yak-yong; Kim Jeong-ho made maps, Heo Jun was a physician.

text: 오징어 두 축을 사면 모두 몇 마리일까?
gloss: If you buy two 'chuk' of squid, how many squid is that? — 40: one 축 is 20 squid.

text: 빵 반죽을 부풀리는 효모는 어떤 생물일까?
gloss: What kind of organism is the yeast that makes bread dough rise? — a fungus (a single-celled one), not a bacterium.

text: 유럽과 아시아, 두 대륙에 걸쳐 있는 도시는?
gloss: Which city lies on two continents, Europe and Asia? — Istanbul; Ankara is wholly in Asia, Athens in Europe, Cairo in Africa.

text: ‘아라비아 숫자’라 불리는 0부터 9까지의 숫자는 본래 어디에서 처음 쓰이기 시작했을까?
gloss: Where did the so-called 'Arabic numerals' 0-9 first come into use? — India; Arab scholars carried them to Europe.

text: 백열전구 필라멘트에 쓰이는, 원소 기호 W인 금속은?
gloss: Which metal with symbol W is used for incandescent-bulb filaments? — tungsten (from 'wolfram').

text: 황금빛 장식으로 유명한 〈키스〉를 그린 오스트리아의 화가는?
gloss: Which Austrian painter made the gold-ornamented 'The Kiss'? — Gustav Klimt; Schiele and Kokoschka are also Austrian, Munch is Norwegian.

text: 삼국사기에 따르면 고구려에서 중국의 칠현금을 고쳐 거문고를 만들었다고 전하는 사람은?
gloss: According to the Samguk sagi, who reworked the Chinese seven-string zither into the geomungo in Goguryeo? — Wang San-ak; Ureuk is tied to the gayageum, Ok Bo-go was a Silla geomungo master, Bak Yeon a Joseon court musician.
